name: Kyusendo Cave
description: Kyushu's largest limestone cave, in the Kuma river valley of Kumamoto; the 4.7 km cave offers a 1 km tourist course through underground streams and grand chambers.
notes: Admission ¥1,100 (adult); a shuttle bus links the entrance and exit. Pair with the Hitoyoshi river boats nearby.
